prerequisites: Optional aggregated metrics API must actually be served; metrics-server is not assumed installed.
Host discovers exact GVR, scope, schema and verbs, and separately checks query permission and availability.
Only v1beta1 has a tailored provider. Unknown versions retain host read-only fallback.
No ordinary create, edit, delete, status edit, installation or companion workload operation exists.
ownershipPolicyMeaning: Generated read-only measurements regardless of actual producer; policy never grants discovery, verbs, authorization, or service availability.
sourcePolicy: Host retains canonical source unchanged. Read-only source preview masks sensitive metadata. No projection is submitted. Filter state stays local and does not persist.

query.output: Exact NodeMetricsList or PodMetricsList from host-scoped transport; list item TypeMeta omission is supported.
query.resultPolicy: Host owns execution, cancellation, session generation and requestResult. Query result is explicitly separate from unchanged source snapshot. Error, sensitive, malformed and unsupported results never become zero usage.
